plugins.name: enpitech
plugins.description: Multi-language code review and developer tools for Claude Code — supports React, Node.js, Python, any language, dependency auditing, and fullstack cross-layer reviews.

skills.name: cr-deps
skills.description: Run a dependency health audit checking for vulnerabilities, outdated packages, deprecations, license issues, and unused dependencies. Use when auditing project dependencies or checking supply chain security.

skills.name: cr-fullstack
skills.description: Run a cross-layer code review on a fullstack PR diff, auto-detecting languages and applying the appropriate criteria for each layer. Supports any combination of React, Node.js, Python, and other languages.
headings: Step 3 — Apply language-specific criteria per layer

skills.name: cr-general
skills.description: Run a 5-pass language-agnostic code review scoped to the current PR diff. Use when reviewing pull requests for any language or framework that doesn't have a dedicated skill (Vue.js, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, etc.).

skills.name: cr-node
skills.description: Run a 7-pass Node.js code review scoped to the current PR diff. Use when reviewing pull requests for Node.js/Express/Fastify backends, checking code before merge, or when the user asks for a Node.js code review.

skills.name: cr-python
skills.description: Run a 7-pass Python code review scoped to the current PR diff. Use when reviewing pull requests for Python/Django/Flask/FastAPI projects, checking code before merge, or when the user asks for a Python code review.

skills.name: cr-react
skills.description: Run a 7-pass React/Next.js code review scoped to the current PR diff. Use when reviewing pull requests, checking code before merge, or when the user asks for a React code review.

skills.name: cra-fullstack
skills.description: Run a full-codebase cross-layer audit, auto-detecting languages and applying the appropriate criteria for each layer, plus system-level checks and dependency audit. Supports any combination of React, Node.js, Python, and other languages.
headings: Step 3 — Apply language-specific criteria per layer (full codebase)

skills.name: cra-general
skills.description: Run a full-codebase 5-pass language-agnostic audit with system-level checks and dependency audit. Use when auditing an entire project in any language that doesn't have a dedicated skill (Vue.js, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, etc.).
headings: Step 3 — Run 5 review passes across all source files

skills.name: cra-node
skills.description: Run a full-codebase 7-pass Node.js audit with system-level checks and dependency audit. Use when auditing an entire Node.js project or performing a comprehensive backend code quality review.
headings: Step 3 — Run 7 review passes across all source files

skills.name: cra-python
skills.description: Run a full-codebase 7-pass Python audit with system-level checks and dependency audit. Use when auditing an entire Python project or performing a comprehensive code quality review.
headings: Step 3 — Run 7 review passes across all source files

skills.name: cra-react
skills.description: Run a full-codebase 7-pass React/Next.js audit with system-level checks and dependency audit. Use when auditing an entire project, checking for architectural issues, or performing a comprehensive code quality review.
headings: Step 3 — Run 7 review passes across all source files

skills.name: figma-to-code
skills.description: Convert Figma designs to pixel-perfect, responsive code. Use when implementing UI sections from Figma files. Requires Figma MCP and Playwright MCP servers running. Handles breakpoints, design tokens, asset export, and visual verification.
headings: 3.6 Pre-implementation verification: Asset vs Element classification
Option B: Copy into your project (works with any AI tool)
